info.name: Aajhee API
info.description:
Discount Discovery API — categories, offers, map, consumer & business accounts.

**Quick start**
1. Import `Aajhee-Production.postman_environment.json` (or Local).
2. Select the environment in Postman.
3. Run **Auth → Consumer Login** or **Business Login** to store JWT tokens.
4. Call protected endpoints in the Consumer / Business folders.

**Live docs:** https://api.aajhee.com/api/docs/
**OpenAPI schema:** https://api.aajhee.com/api/schema/

Discover map: branches within radius_km of lat/lng or the saved address. Does not change saved addresses.

item.name: Consumer

request.description: All offers the user has redeemed, newest first, with branch details.
Poster QR flow: resolve offer + branch + payment. Add &bill_amount=80.00 for percentage offers. No business dashboard needed.
Preview amount to pay before scanning. bill_amount required for percentage_bill offers; omit for item offers.
Get qr_code from an offer list/detail response first. bill_amount required for percentage_bill offers. Response includes payment.amount_to_pay.
Single-step poster flow: scan + redeem. Customer shows payment.summary screen at counter. bill_amount required for percentage offers.
bill_amount required for percentage_bill offers. Response includes payment.amount_to_pay.

body.raw:
{
  "offer_type": "percentage_bill",
  "title": "10% off entire bill",
  "description": "Weekday lunch special",
  "discount_percent": "10.00",
  "usage_limit_type": "one_time",
  "usage_limit_count": 1,
  "branch_ids": [
    1
  ],
  "is_online": false,
  "is_enabled": true,
  "is_time_limited": false
}

request.description: Deal/bundle offer: included_items (at least two names) plus a deal price. Empty external_url_label defaults to View Deal.

body.raw:
{
  "offer_type": "deal",
  "title": "Zinger Box",
  "included_items": [
    "Zinger burger",
    "Regular fries",
    "Soft drink"
  ],
  "discounted_price": "8.99",
  "usage_limit_type": "once_per_week",
  "usage_limit_count": 1,
  "branch_ids": [
    1
  ],
  "is_online": false,
  "is_enabled": true
}

request.description: Online-only offer: set is_online=true and omit branch_ids (or send an empty list). Branches are optional when online.

body.raw:
{
  "offer_type": "percentage_bill",
  "title": "Online 15% off",
  "description": "Available on the web shop only",
  "discount_percent": "15.00",
  "usage_limit_type": "one_time",
  "usage_limit_count": 1,
  "is_online": true,
  "external_url": "https://shop.example.com/deal",
  "external_url_label": "Shop online",
  "is_enabled": true,
  "is_time_limited": false
}

request.description: Staff/superuser JWT. Saves token to environment automatically.

Scrapes a public product page into an offer draft (does not create). With GEMINI_API_KEY set, fills missing fields and adds suggested_category / suggested_discount_percent / suggested_discount_copy. Response includes ai_enriched and confidence.
